text: Its pendulum swung back and forth. <break time="0.8s" /> With a dull, heavy sound. <break time="0.8s" /> And every hour. <break time="0.8s" /> The clock struck with a deep, strange note. <break time="0.8s" /> The sound was so loud and peculiar. <break time="0.8s" /> That the musicians had to stop playing. <break time="0.8s" /> And the dancers stopped dancing. <break time="0.8s" /> For a moment. <break time="0.8s" /> The whole merry crowd was troubled. <break time="0.8s" /> And even the wildest guests turned pale. <break time="0.8s" /> The older guests passed their hands. <break time="0.8s" /> Over their foreheads. <break time="0.8s" /> As if they were lost. <break time="0.8s" /> In a confused dream. <break time="0.8s" /> When the echoes died away. <break time="0.8s" /> Light laughter spread through the rooms. <break time="0.8s" /> And the musicians smiled. <break time="0.8s" /> At their own nervousness. <break time="0.8s" /> They whispered promises. <break time="0.8s" /> That they would not be so troubled. <break time="0.8s" /> The next time the clock struck. <break time="0.8s" /> But after sixty minutes. <break time="0.8s" /> Or three thousand six hundred seconds. <break time="0.8s" /> The clock struck again. <break time="0.8s" /> And everyone was troubled. <break time="0.8s" /> Just as before. <break time="0.8s" /> Still it was a lively party. <break time="0.8s" /> For the prince loved bright colors. <break time="0.8s" /> And strange effects. <break time="0.8s" /> And he had planned every decoration himself. <break time="0.8s" /> Some people would have thought. <break time="0.8s" /> That he was mad. <break time="0.8s" /> But his followers felt sure. <break time="0.8s" /> That he was not. <break time="0.8s" /> The guests wore wild costumes. <break time="0.8s" /> And moved through the seven rooms. <break time="0.8s" /> Like figures in a dream. <break time="0.8s" /> Until the clock struck once more.
